page.overview:
Who is Weather Report?

An amnesiac at his introduction, Weather Report is a fellow inmate who seeks his memory and allies himself with Jolyne Cujoh. It is revealed that he is Enrico Pucci's . Weather is a Stand User controlling the surrounding atmosphere through his ability, which is also named Weather Report.

Weather Report is a man of tall stature and medium to athletic build. He commonly wears a light, flat-topped buffalo hat (a fur hat with two short horns at its front), and a dark bodysuit.

When he was 16 and known as Wes Bluemarine, he wore a similar bodysuit, only with different colored sleeves, and the top half of the suit being cut, looking like a shirt. He didn't wear a hat, instead showing his real hair. His hair is similar to his hat, only excluding the horns, it's smaller, and has several strands going behind his neck.

After Pucci's fusion with The Green Baby, Weather is shown to have gained a star-shaped birthmark on his left shoulder - imitating Pucci's development of the same birthmark - which foreshadowed his familial relation to him.
